discord.account.link.description: Would you like to add another Discord server to integrate it into your automation with the help of Taskwolf? Just click on the logo.
discord.trigger.user.join.name: User joins server
discord.trigger.user.join.description: Is triggered when a player enters the server
discord.trigger.user.join.input.server.d: The server on which the joins are to be monitored
discord.trigger.channel.message.name: Receive new channel message
discord.trigger.channel.message.descript: Is triggered when a new channel message is received
discord.trigger.channel.message.input.se: The server on which the message is to be received
discord.trigger.channel.message.input.ch: The channel on which the message is to be received
discord.trigger.user.mention.name: User is mentioned
discord.trigger.user.mention.description: Is triggered when a user mentions another user
discord.trigger.user.mention.input.serve: The server on which the mention is to be received
discord.trigger.message.reaction.name: New message reaction
discord.trigger.message.reaction.descrip: Is triggered when a user reacts to a message
discord.trigger.message.reaction.input.s: The server on which the reaction is to be received
discord.trigger.message.reaction.input.m: The ID of the message for which the reactions are to be monitored
discord.action.channel.message.name: Send channel message
discord.action.channel.message.input.ser: The server on which the message is to be sent
discord.action.channel.message.input.cha: The channel in which the message is to be sent
discord.action.channel.message.failure.s: An error occurred while sending a discord channel message. The error occurred because the selected server could not be found.
